def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta
    
    # Parse the input date
    year, month, date = map(int, day.split('-'))
    
    # Calculate the target month and year
    total_months = year * 12 + month - 1 + n
    target_year = total_months // 12
    target_month = total_months % 12 + 1
    
    # Determine if the original day is the last day of its month
    # by checking if adding 1 day changes the month
    original = datetime(year, month, date)
    next_day = original + timedelta(days=1)
    is_last_day_of_month = next_day.month != month
    
    # Find the last day of the target month
    if target_month == 12:
        last_day_of_target = datetime(target_year + 1, 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
    else:
        last_day_of_target = datetime(target_year, target_month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
    
    last_day_num = last_day_of_target.day
    
    # Apply the billing rule
    if is_last_day_of_month:
        result_day = last_day_num
    else:
        result_day = min(date, last_day_num)
    
    # Format and return the result
    return f"{target_year:04d}-{target_month:02d}-{result_day:02d}"
